styles.name: Textured Abstract
styles.base_description: Thick impasto-style oil painting aesthetic, bold palette knife marks, three-dimensional texture visible in the image. Appeals to buyers decorating modern, minimalist, and boho interiors. Neutral colour palettes outsell vibrant ones 3:1 in this category.
styles.technique_hint: impasto oil painting, palette knife texture, thick paint application

styles.name: Impressionist Landscape
styles.base_description: Loose painterly brushwork in the tradition of Monet, Pissarro and Renoir. Atmospheric light, visible paint texture, emotional warmth. Consistently one of the top-selling categories for wall art globally — landscapes feel universally safe and calming to buyers.
styles.technique_hint: loose impressionist brushwork, atmospheric perspective, visible paint texture

styles.name: Nature and Botanical
styles.base_description: Detailed botanical studies combining scientific precision with artistic beauty. Watercolour and gouache aesthetic, white or cream background. Strong sellers on Etsy for nurseries, kitchens, home offices, and as gifts. Sets of 3 or 4 matching botanical prints are particularly high-converting.
styles.technique_hint: botanical watercolour study, precise linework, transparent washes
variations: Lush tropical monstera leaves, deep emerald and forest green

Fern frond study, muted green on cream parchment

styles.name: Floral Pop
styles.base_description: Bold, oversized floral paintings with graphic intensity and saturated colour — the breakout trend of 2026 on Etsy. Maximalist composition, strong contrast, contemporary art fair aesthetic. These photograph exceptionally well for Etsy listings and drive impulse purchases from buyers scrolling on mobile.
styles.technique_hint: bold graphic florals, saturated colour, maximalist composition, contemporary acrylic

styles.name: Contemporary Portrait / Figurative
styles.base_description: Modern figurative art and portraiture with expressive brushwork. No specific real people — abstract or silhouette-based figures only. Strong sellers in the higher price bracket. Popular with buyers furnishing living rooms, home offices and studios.
styles.technique_hint: expressive figurative brushwork, abstract silhouette, gestural marks
